meta.parties: R. M. Fernando v. Commissioner of Income Tax

rules.statement: The Board of Review should draft the case stated with care and attention, setting forth fully in serially numbered paragraphs the facts on which arise the questions of law for this Court to decide.
rules.supporting_quote: "The function of the Board under the statute is to state as fully as car is done in the document entitled 'Case Stated' in serially numbered paragraphs in ordered sequence the facts on which arise the questions of law this Court has to decide."
